 Additional Public Prose
 Order

This Writ Petition has been filed seeking a direction to the respondents to grant permission and adequate police protection for conducting Higher Educational guidance programme and food grains for students at Karur Prem Mahal on 12.04.2025 and 13.04.2025 by considering the representation dated on 21.03.2025.
2.According to the petitioner, he is an active member of AIADMK party and also 14th ward councillor of Karur Corporation.

The Karur District AIADMK party intending to conduct various by distributing welfare schemes to the general public and awareness programmes and to conduct general public meetings in the District in a peaceful manner.

Likewise, this year also they are going to conduct higher education guidance for school students and awareness programme of grain foods https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 11:15:59 am ) festival on 12.04.2025 and 13.04.2025 at Karur Prem Mahal.
While so, they sent a representation seeking permission for conducting the above said programme and the same has not been considered.
Hence this petition.

3.The learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent police would submit that the petitioner has not produced the certificate from the Food Safety Officer for conducting the food festival and also not stated about the medical facilities arranged to the students.
Therefore, they called for some particulars from the petitioner and he has not filed any documents.
Therefore, the petitioner's representation is pending for consideration.
4.Considering the prayer sought for in this petition and the programme is only related to conducting of awareness programme to the student for higher educational guidance and also to explain the grains and the learned Counsel for the petitioner also assured that they will not conduct any food festival and only explain about the grain foods, therefore, the respondent also has no objection for conducting higher educational guidance programmes, without conducting any food festival.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 11:15:59 am )

5.In view of the same, this Court directs the third respondent to consider the petitioner's representation and grant permission by imposing certain conditions, within a period of two days,
from the date of this order, in accordance with law.
